title: What If You Flew a Jet Straight to the Sun?

scenes.text: What if you flew a passenger jet to the Sun? You would need a very long lifetime.
The Sun is about ninety-three million miles away. Light gets here in just over eight minutes.
A jet at five hundred miles an hour needs more than twenty-one years of nonstop flying.
Drive there at sixty miles an hour, and it takes about one hundred and seventy-seven years.
Walk there, and it takes more than three thousand years.
The fastest spacecraft ever, Parker Solar Probe, hits four hundred thirty thousand miles an hour. Even it dives only close, not into the Sun.

description:
What if you flew a jet to the Sun?
At 500 mph it takes over 21 years, a car needs about 177 years, and walking more than 3,000 years.
